title: FeaturizeSpec
description: A point-in-time (leakage-free) featurization spec for churn-style data (ARC-12 / FEAT-6, #388; part of the native distributed accelerated compute pass for UC-1 churn — #264). It expresses the shape of churn_features.sql as a DDF graph: per-entity windowed event aggregates (every feature uses time <= as_of, so a feature computed as of t0 never sees a future event) joined onto a static account dimension. Realized by zetta::ddf::point_in_time_featurize via the as-of window op (as_of.hpp), the groupby-aggregate op (group_by.hpp), the filter op (ops.hpp), and the equi-join op (join.hpp); distributed via run_featurize_job (featurize_job.hpp). Mirrored by zetta::ddf::FeaturizeSpec in include/zetta/ddf/featurize.hpp and enforced by FeaturizeSpec::from_json() in src/core/ddf/featurize.cpp — keep them in sync.

entity_column.description: The integer-dtype entity-key column, present in BOTH the events frame and the accounts frame (the join key). Each distinct value is one entity (account) — the row unit of the feature table.

time_column.description: The numeric timestamp column in the events frame (e.g. epoch seconds, or any monotonic encoding of time). Compared against as_of / window_start to window each feature.

as_of.description: The point-in-time cutoff t0 (inclusive): every event feature aggregates only the rows whose timestamp is <= as_of. The single, global no-leakage boundary.

event_features.description: The windowed per-entity event features. Each aggregates an events column over the window [window_start, as_of] (always <= as_of), optionally restricted to one event type.

name.description: The output feature column name (unique across event_features and account_features).

agg.description: How the qualifying rows reduce into the feature value.

value_column.description: The events column reduced; required for sum/min/max/mean, ignored for count.

window_start.description: Optional trailing-window lower bound (inclusive): a row also qualifies iff its timestamp is >= window_start, giving the window [window_start, as_of]. Omitted for the unbounded-below (-inf, as_of] case. Must not exceed as_of.

type_column.description: Optional events column carrying a numeric event-type code; when set, only rows whose value equals type_value contribute (e.g. count only payment_failed events). Requires type_value.

type_value.description: The numeric event-type code a row's type_column must equal to qualify. Required iff type_column is set.

account_features.description: Static account-dimension columns carried through unchanged from the accounts frame (e.g. mrr, seats, tenure_days), joined onto the windowed event features by entity. Names must be unique and not collide with an event-feature name.

label_column.description: Optional training-target column from the accounts frame (e.g. churned). Carried into the output feature table as the label y, never treated as a feature X. Omitted when the feature table is for scoring rather than training.
